cgate_manual.title: C-Gate Manual
cgate_manual.relevant_contract: DBNETWORKPATH returns 136 COMPACT or 137 OID paths; paths exclude the source, include the destination and allow at most six bridges. Standard bridge path discovery uses the far-side network address for its bridge unit.

serial_interface_guide.title: C-Bus Serial Interface User Guide
serial_interface_guide.relevant_contract: Outbound Network-PCI stack headers are 09, 12, 1B, 24, 2D and 36; incoming smart-mode Reply Network counts are 01 through 06; at most six bridges are permitted

evidence_boundaries: C-Gate 3.4.0_2001 is the selected-version oracle for all retained DBNETWORKPATH command replies and Bridge InterfaceAddress behavior.
The exact outbound routed PINGU byte sequence is retained only as C-Gate 2.11.11 evidence and is independently supported by CBUS-SIUG 1.17.
No native routed reply was produced by physical bridge hardware in this acceptance run.
Reply Network decoding and route reversal are grounded in CBUS-SIUG 1.17 and scripted-PCI tests, not claimed as live hardware acceptance.
No routed write, commissioning mutation, OEM eDLT metadata request or physical persistence claim is supported by this evidence.
